stem_md: 下列函数全微分计算中，正确的有(\quad)个。
analysis_md:
(1) $u_x=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\dfrac{z^2}{x^2+y^2}}}\cdot\frac{-xz}{(x^2+y^2)^{3/2}}=\frac{-xz}{(x^2+y^2)\sqrt{x^2+y^2-z^2}},\quad u_y=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\dfrac{z^2}{x^2+y^2}}}\cdot\frac{-yz}{(x^2+y^2)^{3/2}}=\frac{-yz}{(x^2+y^2)\sqrt{x^2+y^2-z^2}}$

$u_z=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-\dfrac{z^2}{x^2+y^2}}}\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2-z^2}}$

故$du=\frac{-xz}{(x^2+y^2)\sqrt{x^2+y^2-z^2}}dx+\frac{-yz}{(x^2+y^2)\sqrt{x^2+y^2-z^2}}dy+\frac{1}{\sqrt{x^2+y^2-z^2}}dz.$

(2) 在$u(x,y,z)=x^yy^zz^x$两边取对数，得

$\ln u=y\ln x+z\ln y+x\ln z,$

两边求微分，得

$\frac{du}{u}=\ln x\,dy+\frac{y}{x}dx+\ln y\,dz+\frac{z}{y}dy+\ln z\,dx+\frac{x}{z}dz$

$=\left(\frac{y}{x}+\ln z\right)dx+\left(\frac{z}{y}+\ln x\right)dy+\left(\frac{x}{z}+\ln y\right)dz,$

即$du=x^yy^zz^x\left[\left(\frac{y}{x}+\ln z\right)dx+\left(\frac{z}{y}+\ln x\right)dy+\left(\frac{x}{z}+\ln y\right)dz\right];$

(3) $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=6xy+\frac{1}{y},\quad \frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=3x^2-\frac{x}{y^2},$于是

$dz=\left(6xy+\frac{1}{y}\right)dx+\left(3x^2-\frac{x}{y^2}\right)dy;$

(4) $z_x=\cos(x\cos y)\cos y,\ z_y=(-x\sin y)\cos(x\cos y),$于是

$dz=\cos(x\cos y)\cos y\,dx-x\sin y\cos(x\cos y)\,dy;$

(5) $\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}=yzx^{yz-1},\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=zx^{yz}\ln x,\quad \frac{\partial u}{\partial z}=yx^{yz}\ln x,$故$du=yzx^{yz-1}dx+zx^{yz}\ln x\,dy+yx^{yz}\ln x\,dz.$
